title: Installing Motif
description: Download the Windows x64 Setup.exe asset from the Motif Releases page, choosing the beta version named in your invitation. Beta downloads are marked as prereleases. Run Setup and follow the installer. It installs Motif for your Windows user and creates a Start menu shortcut. Launch Motif from that shortcut, then choose Select new… and browse to your FieldWorks .fwdata file. Motif reads your project and changes nothing in it until you choose Apply. Motif is a tech demo. Keep a FieldWorks backup and try it on a copy of your project first.
